name: bolt-python-canonical
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is Bolt for Python (`slack_bolt`), a framework for building Slack apps: it
verifies and parses incoming Slack requests, routes events, messages, actions, commands, shortcuts, views and
options to listeners through listener matchers and global and listener middleware, injects listener
arguments such as `ack`, `say`, `respond`, `client`, `context` and `logger`, runs lazy listeners, authorizes
requests for single- and multi-workspace apps with token rotation, runs the OAuth installation flow, and
provides the `Assistant` and custom-step helpers, with synchronous (`App`) and asyncio (`AsyncApp`) APIs.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the slack_bolt package (every module under slack_bolt/ except the framework adapters under slack_bolt/adapter/ and the legacy Steps from Apps package under slack_bolt/workflows/), together with README.md, docs/english/getting-started.md and every concept page under docs/english/concepts/ except adapters.md, socket-mode.md and adding-agent-features.md, and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is those pages and the
